build_tensorrt_img2img_pipeline: build a TensorRT-accelerated Stable Diffusion image-to-image pipeline with ONNX export and engine optimization
create_tensorrt_engines: create TensorRT inference engines from ONNX models for CLIP, UNet, VAE encoder, and VAE decoder components
run_img2img_inference: run image-to-image generation using TensorRT-accelerated Stable Diffusion with prompt, strength, and guidance scale
optimize_onnx_models: optimize ONNX graphs by cleaning nodes, folding constants, and inferring shapes for TensorRT compatibility
encode_and_decode_images: encode input images to latents via VAE encoder and decode denoised latents back to images via VAE decoder using TensorRT engines
